questions.question: What is the oxidation number of sulfur in the ion SO₄²⁻?

options.explanation: Incorrect oxidation number
Incorrect oxidation number
Correct oxidation number
Incorrect oxidation number

questions.explanation: In SO₄²⁻, the oxidation number of oxygen is -2. Let the oxidation number of sulfur be x. Then: x + 4(-2) = -2 → x - 8 = -2 → x = +6
